# The basics

A page written for the tests. Press `F1` for **help**, read *slowly*, and
continue on the next line of the same paragraph.

## The main window

Open the [research window](window:research) or the [components](help:components)
tab of Help. The [colonies page](colonies) and its
[first section](colonies#founding-colonies) are links to other pages; this
[section](#tips-and-tables) is on the same page.

### The status bar

The top line shows the date and the treasury.
